description: Header file defining the InputFileManager class responsible for managing file loading and parsing in a build system context, including asynchronous and synchronous loading, memory management, and thread safety.

classes.name: InputFileManager
classes.description: Manages loading, parsing, and memory management of input files for a build system, supporting thread-safe operations and dynamic inputs.

methods.name: AsyncLoadFile
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a file and executes a callback upon completion.

methods.name: SyncLoadFile
methods.description: Synchronously loads and parses a file, returning the parse tree root or NULL on error.

methods.name: AddDynamicInput
methods.description: Adds a dynamic input file to manage its memory and parsing data.

methods.name: GetInputFileCount
methods.description: Returns the count of input files managed.

methods.name: AddAllPhysicalInputFileNamesToVectorSetSorter
methods.description: Adds all physical input file names to a sorter for efficient merging and sorting.

methods.name: set_load_file_callback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to override file loading behavior, mainly for testing.
